title: Hataraku Saibou Specials
justification: AniList 109085 (SPECIAL, 5 episode(s) from 2018-10-24) is AniDB 13743's special(s) S2-S6, aired 2018-10-24 to 2019-02-27. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 100977, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 13743, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 80671 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S3 aired 2018-11-18, TMDB 80671 S0E3 2018-11-28), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
